source_snapshot.procedure: Enable TPM/Secure Boot; install Windows Server 2012/R2 and RAID/SDL drivers; Confirm-SecureBootUEFI; UEFI/BMC checks; reboot.
source_snapshot.criteria: OS/DD/FW install with Secure Boot; CSM disabled/Standard Mode; clean normal reboot.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; operator install plus malformed Linux precheck.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: CRITICAL; requires exact media/disk/drivers/security/recovery and Windows-native evidence.

old_problem: The destructive install lacked a bound Windows image/checksum, target disk/controller, RAID/SDL driver manifest, supported security matrix, recovery material and a defined `standard UEFI and BMC` checklist; Linux prechecks cannot prove the Windows result.
disposition_reason: ED-03 explicitly permits images, versions, device identities and project checklists as runtime prerequisites when intent, method and safety are clear. This row unambiguously requires a Windows install, drivers, Secure Boot/TPM, native confirmation, logs and reboot. A closed destructive gate and required signed package prevent execution until parameters exist without keeping the review decision open.
decision_basis: Direct XLSX row 2259 and actual next formal row 2261 (row 2260 is not in the pending queue), same-row AI fields, GPT V2, both historical records and unique identity were reviewed.
Preserve Windows Server 2012/R2 wording; never silently substitute a newer OS. Unsupported platform evidence makes execution BLOCKED/N/A only with signed specification.
Bind ISO hash/license, exact controller/disk serial and backup/reimage authorization before any formatting; revalidate identity after RAID driver load.
Bind full signed RAID/chipset/NIC/VGA/storage/PCIe driver/firmware manifest and Windows-native acceptance, not Linux bootctl/mokutil.

Require TPM physical-presence and CSM-disabled/Secure Boot Standard states, protected recovery keys/media, `Confirm-SecureBootUEFI=True`, approved UEFI/BMC checklist, clean logs and full reboot readiness.
No disk selection/format, BIOS/TPM change, OS/driver/FW install, reboot or DUT action occurred.

test_case.test_name: Authorized Windows Server Secure Boot/TPM installation and clean reboot
test_case.purpose: Install the exact approved Windows Server 2012/R2 image to one authorized storage target under Secure Boot Standard Mode/TPM, load the approved driver/firmware set, and prove native Secure Boot, device, firmware-log and reboot health.
required_package: Supported Windows Server 2012/R2 edition/build/ISO hash/license/install media
Exact target controller/disk/virtual disk identity, backup and reimage authorization
RAID/storage plus full signed SDL driver/firmware manifest
TPM/CSM/Secure Boot/key matrix, recovery media and approved UEFI/BMC/log checklist
test_case.test_command: No autonomous install. After the signed package and destructive one-shot approval, a qualified operator verifies target identity before and after RAID-driver loading, configures approved BIOS/TPM state, installs the bound image/drivers/firmware, runs elevated Windows `Confirm-SecureBootUEFI`, exports device/driver and Windows/UEFI/BMC evidence, reboots once and verifies the signed final state.
test_case.expected_result: The intended disk contains the approved Windows build; every required signed driver/firmware installs without error; CSM is disabled, Secure Boot is Standard/enabled, TPM is in the approved state, `Confirm-SecureBootUEFI` returns True, the approved UEFI/BMC/Windows checks show no disallowed events, and the system reboots to OS Ready normally.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires complete signed runtime package, exact target/media hashes, successful install/device manifest, Windows-native Secure Boot True, approved log comparison and full reboot recovery. Wrong target, unsupported image, missing driver, unsigned/error device, security mismatch or failed reboot is FAIL. Missing runtime package blocks execution, not review.
safety_gate: Destructive gate closed until exact disk serial/controller and backup/reimage approval.
Qualified operator controls physical presence, BIOS, installer, driver loading and target selection.
Protect keys/credentials; preserve logs instead of clearing them.
Stop on identity, media, driver, key, boot or recovery ambiguity; never retry automatically.
expected_evidence: Installer, disk/partition, device/driver and firmware results
Reboot/OS Ready, final state and verdict
test_case.recovery: On wrong-target risk, install/driver/security or boot failure, stop without retry, preserve installer/console/log evidence and restore only through the approved backup/reimage, recovery keys/media and firmware configuration procedure.

source_conflict.reason: Procedure and Criteria consistently define the installation/security goal; package values are runtime bindings.

blocked.reason: A dedicated supported SUT with a signed package can execute the case; unsupported 2012/R2 must be documented separately.
